 Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026: Match 03, UT vs ARA Match Prediction – Who will win today’s match between United Tigers vs Arabian Aces?
 The match will be played at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi.
 By CricTracker Staff Published - 07 Nov 2026, 12:27 IST 
 3 Min Read
 Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026: Match 03, UT vs ARA Match Prediction – Who will win today’s match between United Tigers vs Arabian Aces?. (Photo Source: Abu Dhabi T10) The United Tigers (UT) will take on the Arabian Aces (ARA) in the third match of the Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026 at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium in Abu Dhabi on Saturday, November 7. 
 Both teams will be eager to make a strong start to their campaign and register their first victory of the tournament. With the shortest format of the game demanding aggressive batting and disciplined bowling, both sides will look to make an early statement in the competition. The encounter is scheduled to begin at 9:30 PM IST.

 Sheikh Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi Pitch Report
 The Sheikh Zayed Stadium in Abu Dhabi is expected to offer a good batting surface, with batters likely to enjoy the conditions in this 10-over contest. The shorter format could encourage aggressive stroke play from the outset, while bowlers will need to rely on variations and disciplined lines to restrict the opposition. 
 UT vs ARA Head-to-Head Record
 This will be the first-ever competitive match between the two sides.

 Probable Top Performers from UT vs ARA
 Probable Best Batter: Fakhar  Zaman 
 Fakhar Zaman will be a key batter for the United Tigers. The left-handed opener is known for his aggressive approach and ability to score quickly in the powerplay. He will look to provide his team with a flying start and put pressure on the Arabian Aces' bowling attack. 
 Probable Best Bowler: Abbas Afridi
 Abbas Afridi will be an important bowler for the United Tigers. The right-arm pacer has the ability to pick up crucial wickets and make an impact with his variations. He will look to use his skills effectively and restrict the Arabian Aces' explosive batting lineup.
